description: List the scheduled jobs of an app: those declared in its deployhub.json `cron` array (origin "manifest", kind "exec": a docker exec) and those AppCrane created from the `crons` of its vercel.json (origin "vercel", kind "http": GET http_path on the app's own container, with Authorization: Bearer CRON_SECRET when the app sets CRON_SECRET), as of the most recent deploy. Each entry includes the cron schedule (UTC), the command, when it last ran, the exit code (0 = success; for an http job, a 2xx answer), last_http_status for an http job, and the tail of the last run's output. Use to verify a job was registered, debug a missing run, or read the recent log. App-admin or owner.

stage.description: Optional — omit to list both envs. Target stage (legacy alias: env).

name: appcrane_list_cron
